complete_source_units.text: but lovers of learning should also be able to benefit those outside, both by speaking and by writing, my grandfather Jesus, having devoted himself extensively to reading the law and the prophets

I myself considered it most necessary to contribute some diligence and hard work toward translating this book. During that time I devoted many wakeful hours and much skill to completing the book and publishing it also for those living abroad who wish to learn,
Do not rise up against an insolent person, lest he sit in ambush against your mouth.
There is someone who grows rich through his attention and frugality, and this is his allotted reward:
Do not insist on speaking with him as an equal, and do not trust his many words. For through much talk he will test you and examine you as though smiling.
I will disclose instruction by measure and declare knowledge with precision.
There is someone who makes a promise to a friend because of shame, and has acquired him as an enemy for nothing.
The one who pricks an eye will bring down tears; the one who pricks a heart reveals feeling.
You will entertain and provide drink without thanks, and besides these things you will hear bitter words:
“Come along, guest, arrange the table, and if you have anything in your hand, feed me.
Health and soundness are better than all gold, and a robust body than immeasurable wealth.
Make a servant work, and you will find rest; release his hands, and he will seek freedom.
A scribe’s wisdom comes through the opportunity of leisure; the one whose activity is reduced will become wise.
Having reflected further, I will recount more, for I have become full like the moon at midmonth.
